external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and authorization server.

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application operated by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

external_entities.name: member's phone
external_entities.description: A member's phone on which the mobile app keeps a refresh token.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application that signs members in and calls the rewards API.
processes.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app. The app signs a member in through our authorization server
processes.notes: PKCE challenge status was not recorded.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The authorization server that signs members in, handles partner authorization, and issues tokens.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API called by the mobile app to read and write the points ledger.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: It does not check which client or audience a token was issued for.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: The database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: The ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: The store receiving every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: mobile sign-in
data_flows.description: The member signs in through the authorization server for the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow

data_flows.name: token request
data_flows.description: The mobile app uses the authorization server's authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: PKCE challenge status was not recorded.

data_flows.name: call API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back

data_flows.name: partner sign-in
data_flows.description: The member signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page when connecting a partner app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page

data_flows.name: approve consent
data_flows.description: The member approves the consent screen listing scopes.
data_flows.source_excerpt: approves a consent screen that lists the scopes

data_flows.name: authorization code
data_flows.description: The authorization server returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.
data_flows.notes: The source describes the browser return, while the authorization server is the issuer of the authorization code.

data_flows.name: token request
data_flows.description: The partner app sends a token request containing its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.

data_flows.name: partner authorization
data_flows.description: The partner app interacts with the authorization server for member authorization.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers
data_flows.notes: The text does not describe the specific request data or operation beyond the authorization flow.

data_flows.name: disconnect partner
data_flows.description: The member disconnects a partner app from the mobile app settings screen.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members can disconnect a partner app from the settings screen of the mobile app
data_flows.notes: The action deletes that app's refresh token from the identity database.

data_flows.name: store identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server stores accounts, credentials, authorization artifacts, and consents in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database
data_flows.notes: The authorization server also deletes a disconnected partner app's refresh token.
data_flows.data_description: accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: ledger access
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes received requests and headers to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close account
data_flows.description: The member closes their account through the support console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.

data_flows.name: console token
data_flows.description: The support console takes access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

data_flows.name: close account record
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

data_flows.name: download key
data_flows.description: The rewards API downloads a public key from the authorization server when it starts.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API checks the signature with a public key it downloads when it starts.
data_flows.notes: The text does not explicitly name the authorization server as the key download endpoint.

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organization's cloud account where the cloud-hosted platform components run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: member devices
trust_boundaries.description: The zone outside the organization's control containing members' phones.

trust_boundaries.name: partner servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers operated by other companies that host partner apps.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The authorization server is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: Members and partner applications connect to its sign-in and token endpoints, and the system description states that connections use HTTPS.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API, and the mobile app and partner servers connect to the API.

assumptions.assumption: The support console is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: The support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains member email addresses, password hashes, refresh tokens, authorization codes, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It contains every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store contains confidential data.
assumptions.basis: It stores every request received by the rewards API, including headers; the system uses bearer access tokens in requests.
